acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce with a script test that runs `make -n instruction-conflicts` and record the refusal
Either declare Makefile (plus includes) as a bounded read for such tests, or document the supported way to pin a recipe expansion
A test pins the instruction-conflicts recipe expansion
body: The dogfood-flow lane (claude/batch-dogfood-flow, V1-1756, 2026-10-21) wanted script/check-instruction-conflicts_test.sh to pin the expansion of the `make instruction-conflicts` recipe with `make -n`. tools/unbounded-readers (make unbounded-readers-check) refused the case, presumably because a make invocation reads the whole Makefile and its includes as an unbounded input. So the expansion was checked by hand, and no test pins it. Not reproduced by the orchestrator; the exact refusal text was not retained.
title: Suspected: unbounded-readers-check refuses a script test that runs `make -n`, so Makefile recipe expansions go unpinned
